catalysts.headline: Amendment to Articles of Incorporation increasing authorized shares from 20,000,000 to 200,000,000 (approved at the 10/1 annual meeting) became effective — consistent with preparing capacity for the North Immunology merger/PIPE share issuance.

Annual stockholders meeting (virtual); quorum met (399,752 of 711,136 shares entitled to vote as of the record date, ~56.21%); five directors elected. Explicitly unrelated to any North Immunology merger vote.
Aethlon Medical annual stockholder meeting held (per DEF 14A filed 2026-09-01; unrelated to the North Immunology merger vote)

Aethlon Medical and privately-held North Immunology announced an all-stock merger agreement concurrent with a ~$180 million private placement. Combined company to be named North Immunology, Inc., trading on Nasdaq as NRTX. Aethlon's current shareholders would hold ~4.75% of the combined company; North Immunology holders/PIPE investors ~95.25%. Lead asset: NOR-101, an anti-IL-13 x IL-18 bispecific antibody for atopic dermatitis. Financing intended to fund operations into H2 2028. Aethlon's Hemopurifier program would NOT continue at the combined company; legacy Aethlon assets to be handled via contingent value rights. Deal approved by both boards; expected to close Q1 2027, subject to both companies' stockholder approval, an effective Form S-4, and Nasdaq initial-listing approval. Outside date 2027-06-17. Termination fees: Aethlon payable to North Immunology $300,000; North Immunology payable to Aethlon $2,000,000. AEMD shares rose sharply in pre-market trading (magnitude disputed across sources, roughly 370%-471%).
